title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 During 1996, only 3 States provided training to their Staff. Of the 3 States, Uttar Pradesh ranked high in reporting various training programmes imparted to their staff during the year 1996. State of Nagaland and UT of Delhi could train 33 and 3 staff respectively.
